get.description:
Every delegation (newest first) with its state, which can still be ended early, and the possible deputies
(the other PMO accounts; empty when the deputy has to be typed in).
One ZIP with everything an internal audit needs about an approved decision (audited).
Approved decisions six and twelve months on: did the budget and the end date hold, hit rate per verdict.

Monte Carlo over the open portfolio: probability to stay within budget and the reserve at the confidence
level of the business rules (seeded, reproducible).
Reference class forecast of one project: how comparable projects ended against their first budget.

post.description:
Writes the changes of an approved proposal back to ServiceNow (only when switched on in the mapping and on
the host); a value changed in ServiceNow meanwhile is a conflict and is not overwritten.

get.description: Reported against calculated status of every open project ("reported green, calculated red").
The caller's own proposals still waiting for the PMO, with their deadline state.
Management reserve against its floor and the skill heatmap – the PMO's lever, not a Project Manager's.

Blocked projects and systemic risk clusters in the caller's scope. A predecessor outside the scope appears only
as "projects outside your scope" – no id, no name, no count.
What the page shows the caller: planning horizon, demands in scope and the sections of the role.
The base plan (rank order, today's data): verdict, budget and capacity hot spots, critical chains.
Scored demands open for an assessment (mandatory demands are marked, not scored).
The Board's landing figures: plans waiting, the plan in force, the base plan's verdict today.
Approved demands waiting for their conversion into a project, and the demands already converted.

post.description: The conversion sets a first baseline: a proposal a second PMO approves (POST /proposals/{id}/approve).
Appends the scores (the latest per criterion counts, history stays) – written directly, as on the page.

get.description: What a delay of the demand by 1-4 quarters pushes along (only items in the caller's view are named).
Annual plans submitted to the Portfolio Board; `?status=submitted` is the Board's inbox.

post.description:
The Portfolio Board approves and writes the plan (snapshot first). Never its own; a NO-GO plan only with
`override` and the reason in `comment`.
The Portfolio Board sends the plan back to the PMO with a reason.

get.description:
The plans a board pack can show (approved plan, saved scenarios, base plan); the PMO can also send a scenario
input of its own.

post.description: The multi-year view of a plan (json) or its board pack: Excel workbook (xlsx) or print-ready page (html).

200.description: The multi-year view (json) or the board pack (xlsx, html)

get.description: The choices of the scenario inputs: demands open for planning, scopes, years, budget factor, methods.
Saved plan scenarios (latest status each, newest first); drafts can be submitted by the PMO.

post.description:
Saves the scenario as a draft (input and decision per demand, recalculated on today's data); the approval
follows separately (POST /planning/scenarios/{id}/submit).

One plan scenario on today's data: verdict, decision per demand, budget, capacity (with the heat map as Plotly
figure JSON) and, for the value-optimal filling, what it does differently from the rank order.
Two or three scenarios side by side.
Recalculates the draft on today's data and puts the annual plan before the Portfolio Board.

A weight change decides the rank of every demand: a proposal a second PMO approves (POST /proposals/{id}/approve).
Answers 200 without a proposal when no weight changes.

Reports an actual benefit (an appended Benefit_Actuals row, no proposal – like a status report). The owning
Project Manager and the PMO report.

get.description:
The master-data form: its two sections with every field's input (kind, options, range, value shown, a stored
value outside the range), required/missing, and whether the caller may change it (only the owning Project
Manager edits; approved budget and CapEx/OpEx plan only while empty).

post.description:
Saves one section of the form: 'direct' is written at once (snapshot, audit), 'governed' is submitted to the
PMO inbox as one proposal and written after a second person approves it.
